description: German builds one word where English uses three, and a single word cannot be wrapped: there is no space in Benachrichtigungseinstellungen to break at. Wrapping is no answer, and neither is a box drawn for Notifications - the word simply runs out of it and is cut off mid-syllable. The control must be given room for its longest single word, or made small enough that the word fits, before anything else is considered. There is empty form to the right here, so it may have some of it.
